title: althaea occidentalis
intro: Althaea occidentalis, commonly known as Western marshmallow, is a perennial plant native to North America. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly its ability to soothe and calm irritated tissues, making it a popular natural remedy for digestive issues, skin irritations, and respiratory problems. The health benefits of Western marshmallow include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory effects, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as mucilaginous and demulcent properties. The bioactive constituents of Western marshmallow include polysaccharides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
